relNote: Fixed asset master record; one row per physical or intangible asset owned by the company

def.name: AssetTable
def.description: Fixed asset master record — one row per physical or intangible asset. Contains the asset ID, name, group classification, acquisition date, location, and default financial dimensions. All value model (AssetBook) and transaction (AssetTrans) records link back to AssetTable via AssetId.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: AssetId
fields.note: Primary key — unique identifier assigned to each fixed asset

fields.name: Name
fields.note: Descriptive name of the asset

fields.name: AssetGroup
fields.note: FK to the asset group that governs posting profiles and depreciation defaults

fields.name: AcquisitionDate_W
fields.note: Date the asset was acquired (w/o tax)

fields.name: AcquisitionPrice_W
fields.note: Acquisition price of the asset (without tax)

fields.name: AcquisitionValueNO
fields.note: Full acquisition value including any additional acquisition costs

fields.name: Location
fields.note: Physical location of the asset

fields.name: SerialNum
fields.note: Manufacturer serial number or asset tag

fields.name: DefaultDimension
fields.note: FK to the default financial dimension set for this asset

relNote: Value model (depreciation book) per asset — one asset can have multiple books (e.g. tax book + statutory book). Holds acquisition cost, scrap value, useful life, depreciation profile, and accumulated depreciation.

def.name: AssetBook
def.description: Value model (depreciation book) assigned to a fixed asset. One asset can have multiple AssetBook rows (e.g. a tax book and a statutory book). Defines acquisition cost, scrap value, service life, depreciation profile, and holds running depreciation values.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: AssetId
fields.note: FK to the asset this book belongs to

fields.name: BookId
fields.note: Primary key of the value model / depreciation book (e.g. 'Tax', 'Local')

fields.name: AcquisitionDate
fields.note: Date the asset was acquired under this book

fields.name: AcquisitionPrice
fields.note: Acquisition cost recorded in this value model

fields.name: ScrapValue
fields.note: Residual value at end of useful life (minimum net book value)

fields.name: ServiceLife
fields.note: Total useful life in years for depreciation calculation

fields.name: DepreciationProfile
fields.note: FK to the depreciation profile defining the calculation method

fields.name: DepreciationConvention
fields.note: Enum: 0 = First day, 1 = Last day — determines period boundary for first/last depreciation

fields.name: Status
fields.note: Enum: 0 = Open, 1 = Permanently depreciated, 2 = Disposed

relNote: Individual FA transaction rows — acquisition, depreciation, impairment, disposal. Links to AssetBook (the value model) and creates GL postings via LedgerDimension.

def.name: AssetTrans
def.description: Individual fixed asset transaction rows — one per acquisition, depreciation run, impairment, revaluation, or disposal event. Linked to the AssetBook (value model) and posts GL entries via LedgerDimension.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: AssetId
fields.note: FK to the asset that this transaction belongs to

fields.name: BookId
fields.note: FK to the value model (book) that this transaction applies to

fields.name: TransType
fields.note: Enum: 1 = Acquisition, 2 = Depreciation, 3 = Disposal, 4 = Revaluation, etc.

fields.name: TransDate
fields.note: Date of the transaction

fields.name: AmountCur
fields.note: Transaction amount in the original currency

fields.name: AmountMST
fields.note: Transaction amount in the accounting currency

fields.name: CurrencyCode
fields.note: ISO currency code of the transaction

fields.name: LedgerDimension
fields.note: FK to the GL ledger account and dimensions this transaction posts to

fields.name: Voucher
fields.note: Voucher number linking to the GeneralJournalEntry

relNote: Asset classification group — controls default depreciation profile, posting accounts, and capitalisation threshold for all assets assigned to the group

def.name: AssetGroup
def.description: Asset classification group master. Groups assets by type (Vehicles, Computers, Furniture, etc.) and drives defaults: number sequence for asset IDs, capitalisation threshold, default depreciation profile, and posting accounts for acquisitions and depreciation.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: GroupId
fields.note: Primary key — unique code identifying the asset group (e.g. 'EQ-VEHICLE')

fields.name: Name
fields.note: Human-readable name of the asset group

fields.name: AssetType
fields.note: Enum classifying asset type (Tangible, Intangible, Financial)

fields.name: CapitalizationThreshold
fields.note: Minimum cost above which an item must be capitalised as a fixed asset

fields.name: Location
fields.note: Default location assigned to assets in this group

fields.name: MajorType
fields.note: Major type classification for reporting purposes

relNote: Depreciation method schedule — defines straight-line, reducing balance, or other depreciation calculation rules. Assigned to AssetBook per asset.

def.name: AssetDepreciationProfile
def.description: Depreciation profile master defining the method (straight-line, reducing balance, sum-of-years-digits, units of production) and parameters used to calculate depreciation for each value model. Referenced by AssetBook.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: DepreciationProfileId
fields.note: Primary key — code identifying this depreciation profile (e.g. 'STL', 'RB-30')

fields.name: Description
fields.note: Human-readable description of the depreciation method

fields.name: Method
fields.note: Enum: 0 = Straight-line, 1 = Reducing balance, 2 = Sum-of-years-digits, 3 = Units of production

fields.name: ServiceLifeYears
fields.note: Default useful life in years for assets using this profile

fields.name: Rate
fields.note: Depreciation rate (e.g. 0.20 for 20% reducing balance per year)

fields.name: UsefulLifeMonths
fields.note: Useful life expressed in months (alternative to years)

fields.name: EffectiveFromDate
fields.note: Date from which this profile becomes valid
